Use case: ui-mockup. One complete existing DooKnow LOCAL component on neutral light-gray backdrop, not a full invented host page. Simplified Chinese, crisp natural-size controls, flat white/#f7f8fa, dark #272b3a/secondary#657084, thin #e6e9f1 lines, primary#4566c6,8px radii and restrained shadow. PILOT input is STYLE ONLY, no importing its rail/header/tree/content. Actual source templates determine all titles, field order, controls, permissions and selected state. No protocol requestId/version/hash/cursor/CSRF fields, fabricated success/online states, team/AI/ToDoo features or OS/browser-dialog chrome. Secret data empty or masked only. One coherent selected condition; hidden alternatives remain hidden. Preserve header/close/body-scroll/footer actions and actual disabled guards; do not derive new disabled rules from API constraints.
EXACT actual baseline Import Markdown ENTRY MODAL. Input1 actual matching baseline supplies content and selected initial state; input2 PILOT only style. Crop/redraw only the actual modal, exclude dimmed owner workspace behind it. Title 导入 Markdown and closeX enabled. Source field 导入到 closed directory selector00-Inbox (focused). Below quiet divider, COLLAPSED disclosure 批量导入文件或目录; do NOT render delegated TransferPanel interior or portable-import card outside this closed disclosure.
Exact single-file body 从当前电脑或手机选择一个 Markdown 文件，复制到00-Inbox。原文件保持不变，不会覆盖同名资料。 Dashed file-input container label选择 Markdown 文件, native Choose File / No file chosen in actual baseline (no OS file-picker window). Exact helper 单个文件不超过 256 KiB。文中的图片和附件不会随文件一起导入。 确认导入 button DISABLED because no file. Bottom-right existing 完成 enabled. No import-success/error/selected file summary/batch selection fields/preview or 确认整包 controls, no Cancel replacement for actual完成. Current owner session parent mapped in metadata, no full host redraw.
